total_supply_at_bootstrap.meaning: totalSupply value pre-set in the constructor

underlying_assets_at_bootstrap.meaning: underlying assets owned by the vault at bootstrap

total_assets_before_first_fulfillment.meaning: totalAssets (computeNAV() == assetsDeposited) before the first fulfilment

share_price_integrations_correct.meaning: performance-fee logic, NAV reporting and share-price-dependent integrations produce correct values
share_price_integrations_correct.checkpoint: after bootstrap supply state is in effect

assumptions: totalSupply is denominated in shares and underlying assets in asset units; the report gives no conversion, so the two quantities are compared only against their own literals.

unresolved.description: The intent 'start with zero supply and mint shares only when assets exist' is a conditional minting obligation; the relation_obligation grammar can express the zero-supply start but not the 'mint only when assets exist' conditional without an additional minting relation not stated numerically in the report.

The impact 'performance-fee logic, NAV reporting and integrations relying on share price are wrong' has no numeric or relational definition of correctness; it is encoded as a grounded Boolean outcome.

limitations: The safety relation encodes only the zero-supply start of the intent; the 'mint shares only when assets exist' clause is not represented in the pattern.
The impact is represented as a Boolean correctness outcome because the report gives no numeric share-price or NAV relation.
The report does not disambiguate whether the 1-asset totalAssets state is the first deposit or a later one.
